description: S022 confirms COMOG held a Feb. 24 press conference in Accra and made a domestic-state call, but it gives no attendance figure or evidence of >=50 members of the public.
required_followup: Find contemporary attendance evidence and establish whether the meeting was a qualifying public meeting under the historical manual.

description: For the Feb. 5 Ada lead, only search-result evidence (especially S023) calls the event a protest; the opened retrospective S024 describes a petition allegation of an invasion and does not establish an assembly or a demand to Ghanaian state policy.
required_followup: Obtain contemporaneous readable reporting or an original local record establishing whether people publicly assembled and what demand they directed to the state.

description: No source in the Feb. 5 Ada dossier gives total attendance; casualties, arrests and persons accused of attacking residents cannot substitute for turnout.
required_followup: Find event-level attendance evidence; keep participants and threshold unknown until then.

description: The Feb. 5 Ada action may relate to January candidate GHA202101-E002, but the available material does not establish one continuous physical action. S024 separately discusses Jan. 27 shootings and a Feb. 5 allegation.
required_followup: Compare the January and February source bodies and local event chronology; retain distinct dates unless continuity is directly supported.

description: Senior-staff strike reports conflict on its January start day (Jan. 2 versus Jan. 21), describe a February suspension/return call, and do not identify a February public gathering.
required_followup: Reconcile the original January sources and search for any separately organized public action; do not convert the workforce into an attendance count.

description: June KNUST/Senior Staff reporting refers generally to “various protests since February” without dates, locations, organizers or crowd details that identify a specific February event.
required_followup: Trace the original report and identify dated events, if any, before adding candidates.

description: The saved searches are English-language queries; Ghanaian-language terms and local-language news archives were not systematically searched.
required_followup: Search relevant local-language archives using verified terms and document the language and archive coverage.

description: Open-web searching does not reproduce the historical manual’s systematic LexisNexis “All News” search of selected major, regional and wire sources.
required_followup: Use comparable systematic archives when available; do not claim exhaustive coverage from the open-web pass.

description: The May 2015 manual PDF/text is available and was read, but the additional “Mass Mobilization Coding Procedure,” latest official event-file version, current schema and universe remain unverified at project level.
required_followup: Resolve the additional procedure and coordinator-owned official-baseline gate before any official integration.

description: NewsGhana S020 returned a cache miss; MFWA S023 timed out before article text on two attempts. These are technical retrieval failures, not observed HTTP denials or publisher holds.
required_followup: If additional body evidence is needed, make a fresh exact-URL receipt and full saved manual publisher/origin review immediately before each permitted request; do not infer a denial from these failures.

description: COMOG coverage includes a GNA-byline NewsGhana story (S020), an organizer statement (S021) and Graphic Online (S022); source independence or written-origin relationships are not fully established.
required_followup: Review the exact original pages and any explicit written-origin links; do not count syndicated or organizer material as independent corroboration.

description: The targeted Menzgold query Q017 surfaced petition and dispute reports from other dates but no dated February 2021 public gathering. This search result is a gap marker, not evidence that none occurred.
required_followup: Use local archives or systematic news databases to check whether customers held a February public assembly; preserve no-event uncertainty.
